Emma — thanks for the questionnaire. Looping Ben (sales) and Marissa (security) for the precise details, but high-level answers below and a short matrix attached (residency-summary.pdf) plus a dataflow diagram (hostedapi-dataflow.png).

TL;DR answers:
- Residency: For the hosted API product, customer data is stored in the cloud region you select at account creation (US, EU, APAC). Production request data and derived artifacts (embeddings, indexes) are persisted in that region. Metadata used for routing/telemetry is stored and aggregated in our control plane region but does not contain customer PII.
- Retention: Default retention for request logs and model outputs is 30 days. Embeddings and customer-created resources are retained per the tenant's configured TTL (default 90 days) and can be shortened on request.
- Deletion/Erasure: Customers can request erasure via Support or the Customer Console; we also provide an API endpoint for programmatic erasure. Typical completion SLA: 5 business days for standard erasure; 20 business days if data exists in offline backups/snapshots or under legal hold.
- Backups & Snapshots: Continuous backups and periodic snapshots may retain data longer; snapshots are stored encrypted and excluded from automatic deletion unless a purge is requested and approved.

Next step: Marissa will add the security/evidence-oriented answers (encryption, key lifecycle, backup retention policy, legal-hold handling). Ben, please add procurement/contracting notes (SOC2 evidence, DPA language).

Best,

Emma — digging into the technical specifics you asked for. I kept answers concise and referenced where we can provide artifacts.

1) Physical location of data- Production request and derived artifacts are stored in the cloud region you select (we currently support GCP us-central1, us-east4, eu-west1, ap-southeast1). Control plane metadata (non-PII telemetry, routing info) is stored in our control plane region and is logically separated from tenant data. We can provide a region matrix and short attestation for audit.

2) Persistence windows- Request logs & model outputs: default 30 days.
- Embeddings & customer resources: default 90 days TTL (configurable).
- KV caches and transient inference state: ephemeral (cleared after session inactivity, not written to durable store).

3) Backups, snapshots, and legal hold- Backups: continuous incremental backups retained for 30 days by default; periodic cold snapshots retained for 90 days.
- Snapshots are stored encrypted, and we maintain an index for faster purge when a customer requests erasure.
- Legal holds: if GreenWorks submits a legal hold, we isolate the relevant tenant snapshot and move it to a longer retention class; erasure requests are paused until hold is removed.

4) Deletion workflow & verification- API/console request arrives -> ticketed to Support -> backend job enumerates tenant objects (blobs, embeddings, indices) -> mark-and-sweep purge job runs (removes live objects) -> snapshot purge scheduling (if requested) -> verification report generated.
- Typical timelines: live-object purge completes within 24–72 hours; full completion including snapshot purge and verification report typically 5 business days; with snapshot/legal-hold exceptions up to 20 business days.
- We will provide a signed erasure certificate (PDF) for your records once purge completes.

5) Encryption & keys- At rest: AES-256 with envelope encryption.
- Keys: customer-managed keys (CMK) support available for Dedicated/Private customers; for Hosted API we offer KMS integration (bring-your-key available upon contract).
- Backups/snapshots are encrypted with the same key hierarchy.

6) Evidence & artifacts we can share- SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted), architecture dataflow diagram, retention matrix, erasure playbook (redacted for public sharing). Provided under an NDA or uploaded to your procurement portal.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute technical walkthrough (Marissa + Sofia) to go line-by-line on the questionnaire and mark any items that need contract language.
